Goal: determine why bundled QEMU does not expose its QMP endpoint in the installed macOS flow, fix the confirmed startup problem, and make any future early-QEMU-exit or QMP-readiness failure actionable from the app.

Source: `docs/app-spec.md` §§2, 6, 10 (A-07/A-08), 12; `crates/rootglass-qemu/src/lib.rs` supervised startup and bounded diagnostics; `crates/rootglass-app/src/lib.rs` start error presentation; installed runtime decision in `docs/adr/0002-versioned-desktop-qemu-runtime.md`.
